description: Fetch a public web page and return structured data: page metadata (title, description, canonical URL, language, site name, byline), main content Markdown, ordered headings with levels, and links (text + URL). Deterministic HTML processing, no LLM. Paid via x402 ($0.005 per successful call; the first 5 successful calls per day are free). Returns JSON with schemaVersion, operation, requestedUrl, finalUrl, metadata{title,description,canonicalUrl,language,siteName,byline,publishedTime}, markdown, headings, headingsTruncated, links[{text,url}], linksTruncated, truncated, extraction{...}.

includeLinks.description: Keep hyperlinks and images in the Markdown (default true). When false, link text is kept as plain text.

maxCharacters.description: Maximum Markdown characters to return (default 20000, max 100000).

url.description: Absolute public http:// or https:// URL. Default ports only; no credentials; no IP literals.

name: extract_url_structured
title: Extract URL (structured)
